pullRequest.title: fix(ui): preserve images, child cards and session recovery for repair release
pullRequest.body:
Images could disappear after acknowledgement and before canonical history. Compact Child cards could lose their creation position, while a parent Session conflict could hide a compatible Child's approval. This change retains each accepted image operation, anchors cards to verified creation results, and scopes compatibility and Human decisions to their actual Session.

Child approval stays pending until the backend confirms delivered=true. Failures and uncertain outcomes retain the request and show an error; overlapping submissions are fenced, and an older response cannot clear a newer request. Recovery never sends a decision automatically. Runtime progress exhaustion renders as an ordinary Assistant message; canonical pending still controls real Human questions and typed approvals.

Work distinguishes ready-empty, uninitialized, disabled, forbidden and error. Its parser accepts only the eight kind/reason pairs already delivered by Bamboo a473; contradictory pairs report an invalid capability response. Empty initialization requires the existing positive capability, eligibility and exact confirmation payload, and each Session uses its shared admission lock. No permission, backend field, automatic attach/import or feature gate is added. Project scope uses the existing-access HTTP API with no scope-specific login or native requirement.

Current source is `4eaec0e7b14243e453878d9ff82ec1efee49e012`, tree `348d78ac60e9f0dde259cccbf0610226ea73880d`, paired with Bamboo `a473f69b856962dd3dbdbfb2051b4fa4aa6e3041`. Version **2026.10.19** is an unpublished candidate; checked-in metadata keeps the intentional `0.0.0` source placeholder.

Validation:

- Current availability fix: all 40 contract combinations first reproduced **21 failed / 19 passed** on unchanged ce889 production. The fixed client and Work hook files pass **180 tests**, including eight legal pairs, rejection of all 32 illegal pairs, and existing initialization/owner/context guards. Types and lint pass.
- Current versioned artifact passes **45 Work v1 browser cases** across the original desktop, tablet and phone projects, with zero skips. These are HTTP/WS contract fixtures covering explicit setup, canonical rereads, denial, uncertain outcomes, capability qualification and mode/binding recovery.
- One current build/pack verifies all **728 resource files**, inventory and packed bytes. Manifest SHA `524647632922c8a4666c1bdede763f0402d34bdb8402c1c4e70931cc89f16e85`; resources SHA `5ee014ed5365d07f66e8f63b8220f1de56f6a49ff3a6b4a9f14b7f160e5d61d9`.
- Retained approval evidence is attributed to 7c: **285 affected unit tests**, **22 browser passes / 2 existing device skips**. Direct approval inputs are unchanged. Earlier complete CI's ten persistent stale assertions were corrected in four test files without changing transcript, channel isolation, full-set review or no-mutation assertions; the targeted original-device run passed **33 cases / 21 existing skips**. No workflow, runner, timeout, retry or new skip changed.
- Source-bound a473/20d evidence retains **14 passing actual browser cases**: compatibility six, compact Child two, exhaustion two, new vision two, and existing actual ViewImage results two. Twelve were read-only with unchanged canonical data. This is not relabeled as a current-head rerun. Captured nonvision wire separately proves zero main image parts and the actual production ViewImage/attachment/auxiliary-image/ToolResult path. Responses are bounded synthetic transport, not a visual-quality claim.

Work initialization and its flight were introduced by 666624e1 **inside this PR**, not in its base or published Lotus16/17. Both bounded Work corrections consume initialization guards already present in a473/the fixed cut through merged Bamboo PR1975. The original publisher explicitly accepted the ce889→4eaec scope replacement; that scope review does not accept CI, artifacts or a formal pin. Current local receipt SHA: 41c68c81ba64f5162608f29ce33e157f455db41bde61403d17238cf0f026303c.

A separate legacy boundary remains disclosed: ChildApprovalRequested lacks the complete durable CAS identity required by a473's legacy endpoint, whose manual pending producer is not wired by the current default actor. The real completed Child used typed allow_once. This patch retains/reports failed legacy delivery; it does not invent CAS fields or implement that separate protocol.

Tickets2063/2079/2090, independent spawn v2, selective continuation and the unconfirmed other-machine retry incident are excluded. No user configuration, credentials, scope grant or paid model call changes.

Current-head Code/Security are completed with zero findings and no unresolved threads. Normal PR CI [39319953694](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/39319953694) and complete workflow_dispatch [39321279995](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/39321279995) are successful on this exact source. Each Node job passes 3839 unit tests and 615 browser cases with 117 existing skips. Fixed-a473 Real Bamboo passes 10 cases with 3 existing skips, plus current-source local and HTTPS surfaces each pass one selected case with two original mode skips. Product merge, accepted tag/controller registration, publication and fresh registry verification remain separate.

Refs #322, #331, #382; bigduu/Bamboo-agent#2077, bigduu/Bamboo-agent#2016, bigduu/Bamboo-agent#2076, bigduu/Bamboo-agent#2088.
